result.edit: Removed the duplicated 3'd6 case item and added the missing begin/end around the case statement in the always block; the duplicate case label was the only functional deviation, so the case now has unique labels 0,5,6 with default.
result.replacement_rtl:
module JG3(ABC,X,Y);
	
	input [2:0] ABC;
	
	output X, Y;
	reg X, Y;
	
	always@(ABC)
	begin
		case(ABC)
			3'd0: begin X<=0;Y<=1; end
			3'd5: begin X<=1;Y=0; end
			3'd6: begin X<=1;Y=0; end
			default: begin X<=0;Y<=0; end
		endcase
	end
	
endmodule
